stateDefinitions.IMPLEMENTED: Code and focused tests exist on the branch.
stateDefinitions.PARTIAL: A typed or visible foundation exists, but production wiring or outcome evidence is incomplete.
stateDefinitions.READY: The task is fully specified for the coding agent but not yet implemented.
stateDefinitions.OWNER_GATED: Internal preparation may exist, but the next material action requires the owner.
stateDefinitions.PLANNED: The requirement is documented but has not reached a coding-ready or implemented state.

requirements.requirement: Tie NOVA into the GSE website and preserve GSE/GSN as the canonical product and company.
requirements.next: Validate authenticated browser rendering and keep all NOVA routes internal-only.

requirements.requirement: Keep the human in command and prevent autonomous installs, spending, applications, outreach, publication, deployment, data sharing, and production mutation.
requirements.next: Preserve deny-by-default authority in every new persistence, tool, and connector surface.

requirements.requirement: Give the coding agent complete what, why, when, how, acceptance, evidence, agent-owned, and owner-only instructions.
requirements.next: Use the ranked founder queue rather than reconstructing work from chat history.

requirements.requirement: Improve founder efficiency through bounded daily decisions, owner-minute accounting, model-role separation, memory layers, and nightly autopsy.
requirements.next: Persist daily briefs and autopsies only after the schema and privacy review are approved.

requirements.requirement: Bound work in progress to one revenue implementation, two experiments, one urgent risk response, and five daily decisions.
requirements.next: Enforce the same limits in future persistence and worker code.

requirements.requirement: Create an immediate first-cash path that uses Garrett's HR, judgment, writing, and AI systems expertise without mislabeling personal income as GSN revenue.
requirements.next: Build and validate the fixed-scope AI Opportunity, Cost, and Workflow Audit offer; owner must approve price, payment, outreach, and contracts.

requirements.requirement: Remove Claude or Codex subscription exhaustion as a complete development stoppage through a local coding lane.
requirements.next: Capture hardware truth, select one local runtime and model, use isolated worktrees, and benchmark one bounded repository task.

requirements.requirement: Account for all 11 Instagram discoveries and 17 HubSpot newsletter redirects without promoting them to evidence or leaking tracking tokens.
requirements.next: Resolve topics and canonical destinations privately, then replace useful claims with primary evidence.

requirements.requirement: Account for the full user-reported Claude plugin inventory, including the latest 110 additions.
requirements.next: Runtime-verify only the small task-relevant subset before use; inventory is not approval.

requirements.requirement: Account for current ChatGPT apps, connectors, and installed skill packs without claiming the list is globally complete.
requirements.next: Refresh the runtime inventory when the available app surface changes.

requirements.requirement: Prevent plugin sprawl, context bloat, and supply-chain risk by selecting at most three task-relevant capabilities and holding autonomous, self-modifying, massive, unknown, or sensitive candidates.
requirements.next: Inspect exact skill files and permissions before invoking any selected candidate.

requirements.requirement: Add observability and evaluation for source quality, model use, tool calls, cost, owner attention, latency, and outcomes before increasing autonomy.
requirements.next: Implement local-first telemetry and compare Langfuse, SigNoz, Honeycomb, Grafana, PostHog, and ClickHouse through reversible trials.

requirements.requirement: Treat grants and startup credits as sequential truth states and route only activated balances to compatible workloads.
requirements.next: Add persistence for application, approval, activation, balance, covered service, expiration, and cash-displacement evidence.

requirements.requirement: Build a read-only NOVA ChatGPT app and Codex-compatible plugin surface for briefs, opportunities, sources, credits, and founder decisions.
requirements.next: Create a dedicated MCP server and widget after read models and authentication boundaries are stable.

requirements.requirement: Package NOVA workflows as a portable vendor-neutral skill pack across Claude, ChatGPT/Codex, Copilot, and Grok Build.
requirements.next: Define the canonical skill contract and progressive context-loading fixtures before writing vendor wrappers.

requirements.requirement: Turn the deterministic NOVA core into a production-wired system with persistence, scheduling, receipts, and JARVIS review integration.
requirements.next: Design additive Prisma models, transaction boundaries, idempotency, scheduler locks, retention, and review receipts before enabling production workers.

requirements.requirement: Separate verified facts, inference, assumptions, contradictions, unknowns, lifecycle states, and money states.
requirements.next: Preserve these transitions in persistence and APIs; never allow direct jumps to shipped, approved, activated, or paid.

requirements.requirement: Learn from measured outcomes without allowing automatic production-weight changes or unsupported self-learning claims.
requirements.next: Persist outcome evidence and require independent review before any scoring or policy change.

requirements.requirement: Keep estimates, eligibility, credits, awards, invoices, and paid cash economically distinct.
requirements.next: Carry truth-state labels through every dashboard, export, application packet, and revenue report.

requirements.requirement: Create retained diagnostics so the coding agent can repair failures from evidence instead of rerunning blind.
requirements.next: Keep focused tests, runtime tests, lint, typecheck, and trust-gate logs as short-lived artifacts.

requirements.requirement: Use context efficiently by loading mission and architecture first, then only task-relevant code, tests, and prior decisions.
requirements.next: Benchmark context size, repair rate, time, and quality before making the retrieval pattern a production routing rule.

requirements.requirement: Keep the branch and PR draft until focused and repository-wide validation support review readiness.
requirements.next: Resolve branch-caused failures, run full CI and build, review changed files, update the PR truth, and only then consider merge readiness.
